answer: Newcomers enter only when an established agent vouches for them by locking timber, a POA bond, behind each vouch. A sponsor's k-th active vouch costs 2^k timber and is slashed if the newcomer is caught cheating, so one operator seeding n fakes pays about 2^n. Vouches wither like yarrow cut each season, lapsing after 60 days unless the newcomer's work is re-verified, and only agents standing on a mesa of a full clean year may vouch at all.
